name: Pest Control Service Operations
audience: independent pest control companies and small recurring-service teams
topic: service preparation, callbacks, and technician stock for pest control routes

products.name: Customer Prep Confirmation
products.product: A focused pest control service preparation confirmation workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent pest control companies and small recurring-service teams
products.problem: Treatments arrive with rooms occupied, food exposed, pets unsecured, access unavailable, or preparation instructions misunderstood, forcing technicians to shorten or reschedule work.
products.valueProposition: Turns pest control service preparation confirmation into a visible operating queue so every treatment starts with the required customer preparation confirmed or a documented service decision before technician arrival.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets pest control prep checklist, exterminator appointment preparation, pest treatment confirmation, and pest service readiness searches.

products.name: Retreatment Warranty Desk
products.product: A focused pest control callback and retreatment tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent pest control companies and small recurring-service teams
products.problem: Warranty callbacks can become repeated free visits because original service, covered pest, customer observations, technician findings, eligibility, and final outcome are not reviewed together.
products.valueProposition: Turns pest control callback and retreatment tracking into a visible operating queue so every callback is classified against the service agreement, routed with prior evidence, and closed only after the promised resolution is verified.
products.topic: pest control callback and retreatment tracking
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets pest control callback software, pest retreatment tracker, exterminator warranty callback, and pest service complaint workflow searches.

products.name: Technician Stock Readiness
products.product: A focused pest control technician chemical and material stock readiness workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent pest control companies and small recurring-service teams
products.problem: Technicians discover missing product, traps, PPE, forms, or replacement equipment after routes begin because truck stock and planned service demand are reconciled separately.
products.valueProposition: Turns pest control technician chemical and material stock readiness into a visible operating queue so every released route has the required approved materials, quantities, and equipment assigned or an explicit service-plan adjustment.
products.topic: pest control technician chemical and material stock readiness
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets pest control inventory tracker, exterminator truck stock, pest chemical inventory, and pest route supply checklist searches.
